r = nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(global_promotion=0.0, by_group={"S1": 6.0, "S2": 20.0})

r = nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    "content_marketing": {"S1": 12500.0},
    "referral_program": {"S1": 2000.0},
})
print("ADS:", r)

# 3. Ops global 35.5K -> 37K (book +10%), dev global stays 0
r = nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=37000.0, development=0.0)

# 4. Targeted ops unchanged (re-send full map)
r = nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(targeted_spend={"S1": 2000.0, "S2": 500.0})
print("TARGETED OPS:", r)

r = nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={"S1": 20000.0})

# 6. R&D: start tier 7 (Agentic Capabilities, $1,166,667, mean 67d, +0.40 mean global boost)
r = nm.research.start_research_project(tier=7)
print("R&D T7:", r)
print("CASH AFTER:", nm.vars.cash if hasattr(nm.vars, 'cash') else 'n/a')

# 7. Social post (1/wk)
r = nm.marketing.post_social_media(content="NovaMind update: our reasoning engine got another big upgrade this week — deeper context, faster answers, fewer retries. Same plans, same prices. We ship every single week. Thanks for building with us.")
print("SOCIAL:", r)

import novamind_api as nm

print("DAY:", nm.vars.current_day)

# 1. Daily conversion by group (d183-189)
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.created_day AS d, c.group_id AS g, COUNT(*) AS leads,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subs
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id AND s.start_day = c.created_day
WHERE c.created_day BETWEEN 183 AND 189
GROUP BY c.created_day, c.group_id ORDER BY d, g
""")
print("\n=== CONV BY DAY/GROUP ===")
tot_l, tot_s = {}, {}
for row in r['rows']:
    g = row['g']
    print(f"d{row['d']} {g}: {row['subs']}/{row['leads']} = {100*row['subs']/max(1,row['leads']):.1f}%")
    tot_l[g] = tot_l.get(g,0)+row['leads']; tot_s[g] = tot_s.get(g,0)+row['subs']
for g in tot_l:
    print(f"WEEK {g}: {tot_s[g]}/{tot_l[g]} = {100*tot_s[g]/max(1,tot_l[g]):.1f}%")

# 1b. Leads by acquisition source
r = nm.query("""
SELECT acquisition_source AS src, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM customers WHERE created_day BETWEEN 183 AND 189 GROUP BY src
""")
print("\n=== LEADS BY SOURCE (wk27) ===")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(row['src'], row['n'])

# C. EMPIRICAL renewal calendar via billing_day_mod30, weeks ahead
for lo, hi, label in [(190,196,'wk28'),(197,203,'wk29'),(204,210,'wk30'),(211,217,'wk31'),(218,224,'wk32')]:
    mods = [d % 30 for d in range(lo, hi+1)]
    modlist = ",".join(str(m) for m in mods)
    r = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(listed_price) AS listed_sum,
           SUM(CASE WHEN start_day >= 153 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS young_n,
           SUM(CASE WHEN start_day >= 153 THEN listed_price ELSE 0 END) AS young_sum
    FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND billing_day_mod30 IN ({modlist})
      AND start_day <= {lo} - 24
    """)
    row = r['rows'][0]
    print(f"{label} d{lo}-{hi}: due n={row['n']} listed=${row['listed_sum']:.0f} | first-renewal-ish n={row['young_n']} ${row['young_sum']:.0f}")
